citations.quote: it may not be possible for a SEOCH Participant to settle its delivery obligations on T+2 by acquiring the underlying securities in the underlying cash market on T+1

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: When a Hong Kong stock option is exercised the exercise day is trade day T and stock settles T+2; because assignment results are known only after T's cash-market close, an assigned short-call writer cannot simply buy the shares on T+1 to deliver on T+2 and may need stock borrowing to settle on time.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: HK Exercised-Option Settlement: Exercise Day = T, Delivery T+2
